title: Canada to lead trade mission to India
excerpt: Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu will lead nearly 300 delegates to India from October 12 to 17, 2026.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on October 9, 2026, that the Honourable Maninder Sidhu, Minister of International Trade, will lead a Team Canada Trade Mission to India. The mission will include stops in Mumbai and Bengaluru.

From October 12 to 17, 2026, Minister Sidhu will lead nearly 300 delegates to connect with Indian decision makers, industry players and potential clients. The delegation includes businesses from the aerospace and space, clean technologies and energy transition, information and communication technologies, life sciences and agri-food sectors.

According to the Government of Canada, this is the largest trade delegation Canada has sent to India in over 30 years. Two-way goods and services trade between Canada and India totalled $30.4 billion in 2025.
topic: Minister Sidhu to lead Team Canada Trade Mission to India to unlock new bilateral trade opportunities
